name: Cedwyn site-wide version scheme
rule: The newest version of any product (each e-book, each documentary scene) is v0.0.2 and costs £4.99. The version before it is v0.0.1 and is free. Older versions count backwards by creation date starting at -v0.0.2: -v0.0.2, -v0.0.3, -v0.0.4 … (most recent older = -v0.0.2; there is no -v0.0.1), all free. Each version is its own version; no ranges. In a hashtag the minus becomes an underscore and nothing goes before it: #v0.0.2, #v0.0.1, #_v0.0.2, #_v0.0.3. A reserved, not yet made version is #next. Prices are unchanged; the bundle stays as listed.

scheme.older: -v0.0.N (N = 2 for the most recent older; the minus series starts at -v0.0.2, rule of 30 Oct 2026 21:50)

readers: /documentary/ (documentary.js 1.6.2 reads this file; built-in defaults match)
/ebooks/ (edition labels and the About versions text follow this rule)
